outcome: cognitive development (Mental Bayley Scales of Infant Development score)
cohort: The study participants were 107 preterm infants with a gestational age of 24-35 weeks.
finding: Cognitive development of two-year-old preterm children with a gestational age of 24-32 weeks was mainly related to their gestational age, and being born preterm and small for gestational age was not additionally associated with cognitive deficits at the age of 2 years, though parents' profession and bronchopulmonary dysplasia were strong predictors.
